jobs.description:
Good decisions start with good data. But good data does not just happen. At NORDEN, data comes from many places and is used across our business to understand markets, automate processes and make better decisions. Your job is to make sure that data is actually ready to be used.

As our new Data Engineer, you will build the pipelines and datasets that move data through our organisation and turn raw information into something people can trust and work with.

You will not be sitting far away from the business maintaining pipelines no one really talks about. You will work closely with digital and commercial colleagues, understand what they need and build the data foundation that helps them solve real problems.

And while shipping knowledge is something you will pick up along the way, curiosity about data and how to make it useful is something we hope you bring from day one.

Why this role?

Because there is a lot to build, improve and figure out.

You will join nine colleagues in our Data Engineering team in Copenhagen, working with large and varied datasets using PySpark, SQL, Azure DevOps and Microsoft Fabric. And our team is growing beyond Copenhagen. We are setting up a Data Engineering team in Singapore, starting with two colleagues, giving you an even broader team to work and share ideas with.

Some days will be about building something new. Others will be about improving what already exists, finding a smarter way to structure data or figuring out why something is not working quite as expected.

What connects it all is the purpose behind it: making data easier to trust, access and use across NORDEN.

You already know your way around data engineering. Now you are looking for a role where you can have more of a say in how things are built, not just build what has already been decided.

You will manage your solutions, contribute to technical decisions and collaborate closely with the business to understand what our data needs to do.

What you will be doing

You will work across the journey from raw data to reliable datasets that colleagues and systems across NORDEN can actually use.

You will:

• Build and maintain scalable data pipelines.

• Bring internal and external data together and turn it into trusted datasets.

• Transform raw data into useful features and insights.

• Improve how we capture, validate and enrich data.

• Build solutions that are reliable today without making life difficult for whoever needs to work with them tomorrow.

• Work with digital and commercial colleagues to understand what they need from our data and translate that into technical solutions.

What you bring

You know that good data solutions are not only about getting things to work, but about making them reliable, scalable and useful to others.

Besides this you likely have:

• Around 5 years of practical experience in data engineering or a similar role.

• A degree within data, IT, engineering or another analytical field.

• Eligibility to work in Denmark.

• Solid experience with Lakehouse architecture, for example in Microsoft Fabric or Azure Databricks.

• Experience designing and building data pipelines and working with how data is structured, transformed and made available to others.

• Experience contributing to technical decisions around data architecture and how data should be structured and used.

• The confidence to be responsible for your solutions, while still enjoying sparring with and learning from others.

• Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Application

Please upload your motivation letter, resume and relevant diplomas via our website as soon as possible and no later than 20 November 2026. Your motivation letter helps us understand what drives you, why you are interested in the role, and how your skills and experiences could contribute to the team. We are especially interested in your motivation and transferable skills, not a recap of your CV. It is your opportunity to tell us the story behind your application.

We review and interview candidates on an ongoing basis.

We will do our best to get back to you at least within ten working days after the application deadline, 20 November 2026.

In NORDEN we value a range of perspectives, educational backgrounds and professional experience and encourages all qualified candidates to apply.

Were you missing anything in this job ad? Please share your feedback with us here.

Our company

We are a global provider of ocean-based freight services for bulk and project cargo of all sizes. We integrate freight solutions with port logistics, helping our customers optimise and decarbonise supply chains. We provide tailored solutions built on flexibility, reliability, and intelligence.

Our agile business model ensures stability by continuously adapting our fleet to market developments and customer needs.

Founded in 1871, NORDEN is one of Denmark’s oldest internationally operating shipping companies. Incorporated in Denmark, we are listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen as part of the OMX Nordic Large Cap index.

With offices across 6 continents, we are a truly integrated part of global trade.

You know shipping. Now you can use that knowledge in a completely different way.

At NORDEN, our core business applications sit right at the heart of how our commercial teams work. But getting the most out of them is not only about the technology. It is about understanding how shipping actually works, how people use the systems every day and where things could work better.

As our new Business Application Manager, you will bring your shipping experience into that space.

You will work with colleagues across NORDEN to improve how we use our core business applications, optimise the processes around them and help turn business needs into better ways of working.

You do not need to come from IT or have worked as a Business Application Manager before. You understand shipping, likely from operations, control/finance or laytime and are curious about how systems and technology can make the business work better.

Why this role?

Because you get to use your shipping knowledge from a completely new angle.

You will join our Business Applications team of six colleagues across Copenhagen, Cyprus and Singapore, working closely with colleagues from the business as well as Digital Services and Solutions.

Your primary focus will be IMOS, but your work will also take you into applications such as SEDNA, PortLog, Shipfix and other tools used across NORDEN.

Some days you might be looking at how a process could work better in IMOS. Others you could be helping colleagues get more out of an application, supporting a new implementation or working with our commercial AI assistant tools.

What connects it all is understanding how people work today and finding ways for our systems and processes to support them better.

Your base will be our office in Hellerup, with occasional travel to other NORDEN offices.

What you will be doing

You will work where shipping, people, processes and technology meet.

You will:

• Analyse how our business applications and surrounding processes are used and identify opportunities to improve them.

• Participate in and lead projects implementing new applications, processes and integrations.

• Train and support colleagues in getting the most out of our applications.

• Work with teams across NORDEN to create better alignment between processes and systems.

• Support and develop the use of our commercial AI assistant tools.

• Work primarily with IMOS while also getting involved with SEDNA, PortLog, Shipfix and other business applications.

What you bring

You do not need to be an IT specialist. What matters most is your understanding of shipping and how these applications are used in practice. You may have used them as an end user up to now, and that experience could be exactly what makes you well suited for this role.

Besides this you likely:

• Have experience from shipping, from operations, control/finance or laytime.

• Have worked with shipping business applications and are familiar with IMOS.

• Are curious about technology, AI and digitalisation and how they can improve the way a business operates.

You are curious about how people work and what could make their day-to-day easier. You listen, ask questions and connect the dots between people, processes and systems, turning what you learn into practical improvements.

Application

Please upload your motivation letter, resume and relevant diplomas via our website as soon as possible and no later than 15 November 2026. Your motivation letter helps us understand what drives you, why you are interested in the role, and how your skills and experiences could contribute to the team. We are especially interested in your motivation and transferable skills, not a recap of your CV. It is your opportunity to tell us the story behind your application.

We review and interview candidates on an ongoing basis.

We will do our best to get back to you at least within ten working days after the application deadline, 15 November 2026.

In NORDEN we value a range of perspectives, educational backgrounds and professional experience and encourages all qualified candidates to apply.

Were you missing anything in this job ad? Please share your feedback with us here.

Our company

We are a global provider of ocean-based freight services for bulk and project cargo of all sizes. We integrate freight solutions with port logistics, helping our customers optimise and decarbonise supply chains. We provide tailored solutions built on flexibility, reliability, and intelligence.

Our agile business model ensures stability by continuously adapting our fleet to market developments and customer needs.

Founded in 1871, NORDEN is one of Denmark’s oldest internationally operating shipping companies. Incorporated in Denmark, we are listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen as part of the OMX Nordic Large Cap index.

With offices across 6 continents, we are a truly integrated part of global trade.

Build Intelligent Systems That Create Real Impact

Are you motivated by solving complex problems with data and AI?

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

About VENZO

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

About the Role

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies within AI and GenAI

For more senior candidates, the role also includes:

• Defining technical direction and architectural standards

• Acting as a primary technical contact for clients

• Leading workstreams and mentoring team members

• Contributing to the evolution of our Data & AI capabilities and service offerings

We value profiles who can combine deep technical execution with sound judgment in real client environments.

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience

• 2+ years of experience in data engineering or AI/ML, delivering production-ready solutions

• Hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle — from experimentation to deployment and monitoring

• Experience with generative AI

• For senior profiles: experience leading technical initiatives or mentoring others

Technical Capabilities

You have experience working within modern data and AI ecosystems, including:

• Programming: Python and SQL, Typescript is a plus

• Cloud: Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure ML, Data Factory) or other cloud plattforms

• Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow)

• Machine Learning: Classical ML techniques and generative AI applications

• GenAI Tooling: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, frameworks such as LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework

• MLOps: CI/CD, model lifecycle management, orchestration tools, version control

• Data Engineering: ETL processes and large-scale data processing

How You Work

• Analytical and structured in your problem-solving approach

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

What You Can Expect From Us

• Meaningful, technically challenging projects with real business visibility

• A strong professional environment with high standards and high trust

• Autonomy in how you structure and deliver your work

• Access to modern tooling, platforms, and certifications (including Microsoft)

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Continuous development — technically and professionally

Let’s Talk

Send your CV or a short introduction to hr@venzo.com.

We’re happy to meet for a coffee and explore whether there’s a mutual fit.

**Job Description

**In order to properly promote our after-sale products and services on the world stage, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (f/m) within Satair (a 100% subsidiary of Airbus) in Copenhagen to join the Marketing team at the earliest possible start date. You will coordinate effectively with members of different departments within Satair and Airbus, as well as external partners, in order to ensure the smooth running of your marketing projects through to completion.

Reporting to our Head of Marketing and Communication Satair and working out of our Headquarters in Copenhagen, with half of the Marketing & Communication team in Hamburg and with commercial teams spread around the world, you will have a global responsibility to drive, prioritize, structure and focus Satair products and services marketing initiatives effectively, in support of our commercial strategy. You will have a unique opportunity to make a difference in this new role which will also require leadership skills as you will indirectly manage a team of specialists to achieve the objectives that you will be setting.

**Tasks & Accountabilities

**

• Craft compelling value propositions, messaging frameworks, and multi-channel marketing campaigns that resonate with aviation industry stakeholders.

• Oversee marketing project lifecycles from concept to completion. You will manage resources, timelines, external agencies, and budget allocation to ensure maximum impact and brand reach.

• You will manage project integrated Marketing & Communication activities through budget control, resources and time-to-market planning, to ensure best ROMI and optimal Marketing & Communication mix, together with the other Product Marketing Managers.

• You will define, set up and continuously improve appropriate state-of-the-art sales enablement materials, digital marketing assets, product marketing materials to be used by the global commercial and product management teams, promoting both traditional offerings and digital e-commerce platforms.

• You will collaborate with our network of external suppliers within the marketing area, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring smooth coordination with external agencies.

• You will work with the Brand Manager and Communication Manager to ensure brand consistency across marketing efforts.

**Required Skills

**

• You have a university degree in marketing (or similar commercial profile)

• You have first working experience in B2B relations

• You have in-depth knowledge of the aircraft after-sales market with a strong sales orientation

• You have demonstrated a track record in creating high-converting marketing content, launching product campaigns, and managing multi-channel promotion strategies.

• You are diplomatic, open-minded with the capability to build successful relations across functions and with all international stakeholders

• You speak English at negotiation level

• You have strong skills in data analytics and data visualization (e.g. Google Analytics) to track and optimize campaign performance.

• You have a great can-do attitude, you see opportunities where others might see challenges

• You are keen to take over transversal projects that are relevant for Satair

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

_Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

_**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

**Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

**Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: **http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

**This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Turn user behaviour into funnels that convert

**About Good Tape

**At Good Tape, we’re building tools that make working with voice and audio effortless. We help journalists, researchers, and organisations capture, transcribe, and analyse conversations at scale. Our team is small, ambitious, and deeply technical, and we care about reliability and craft.

**The role

**At Good Tape we are ready to level up. We've built up tons of data, a large user base, and a team that's eager to move fast.

We have a world class product, shipping speed and roadmap that warrants our ambition level.

We're looking for someone excited to own the path our users actually take through the product; from signup to activation to conversion, and to turn our data into a steady stream of experiments that move the numbers. You'll report directly to our CCO and work closely with our data scientist, on spotting opportunities and blind spots in the funnel, and Growth Marketing Manager, who owns everything that brings people to the door.

It's a rare opportunity; endless data, a real user base and a world class product.

**What You'll Do

**Your responsibilities will include

• Own funnel optimisation and CRO across signup, onboarding, pricing page, and in-product conversion points.

• Design, run, and analyse structured growth experiments end to end.

• Work closely with our data scientist to spot opportunities and blind spots across the conversion path.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to translate product launches into growth experiments and user value.

• Own the conversion funnels of our website; signup flow, pricing page and checkout.

• Feed funnel and experiment data into the pricing and positioning conversations led by our CCO.

**What We’re Looking For

**

• A-can-do-mindset who are curious, humble and tech-savvy enough to build manual processes that we can later scale.

• An AI-first approach to problem solving

• An eye for UX and conversion-focused design is a plus

• Proactive, high-ownership mindset with strong cross-functional communication skills.

• Experience in product-led growth, CRO, or growth product management, and comfort with core SaaS metrics.

• Strong analytical instincts and comfort designing and reading experiments.

• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment with a proven ability to learn quickly.

**Why join Good Tape?

**

• Work in a small, focused, and highly skilled team where your impact is visible every day.

• Play a key role in shaping our product funnels and conversion strategy.

• Help define how Good Tape turns interest into activation and activation into revenue.

• Bring passion and proactivity, and see it directly converted into user value.

**Apply for the job

**We’re excited to see how you can help us make Good Tape even better for our users.

Healthcare Provider AI Solutions Lead

Ballerup

Your impact begins here

As AI Lead, you will shape how Commercial uses data and AI to work with healthcare providers (HCPs) across all affiliates. You will turn Commercial strategy and Novo’s ambitions into a focused portfolio of AI products and analytics that deliver measurable business outcomes, and you will lead a team of around 10 people to build them. Your work will help leaders make better-informed decisions, today, for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You combine hands-on delivery leadership with strong commercial understanding, and you can explain complex AI topics to anyone in the room.

• 
A Master’s degree in Business Management, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field.

• 
10+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, AI, digital product development or commercial technology roles.

• 
Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams across data engineering, data science, analytics engineering, product ownership, AI solution development and business analysis, and building capability and high performance.

• 
A strong track record of delivering enterprise-scale AI, machine learning, analytics or decision-support products from idea to production, including adoption, value tracking and continuous improvement.

• 
Deep understanding of commercial business processes and healthcare provider engagement, and the ability to turn strategic priorities into scalable data and AI products.

• 
Experience working with senior business stakeholders and partners across commercial, medical, IT, enterprise architecture, data governance, privacy, legal and operations.

• 
Strength in roadmap management, prioritisation, resource planning, delivery governance and agile ways of working.

• 
A solid understanding of responsible AI, data governance, privacy, security, validation and compliance in a regulated environment.

• 
Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience in pharmaceuticals, life sciences, healthcare or another highly regulated industry.

What you’ll do

You will own the Commercial HCP Data & AI roadmap and the team that delivers it, from first idea to a product people use every day.

• 
Shape the roadmap: translate Commercial strategy and Novo’s ambitions into a focused portfolio of AI products and analytics, and set the technical and product direction for reusable data assets, conversational AI, decision-support tools and ML models in line with enterprise architecture, security, platform and data governance standards.

• 
Prioritise what matters: run a pragmatic intake process that balances business value, data readiness, technical feasibility, adoption potential, compliance and team capacity.

• 
Lead and grow your team: manage and develop a multidisciplinary team of approximately 10 people, with clear roles, decision rights and ways of working. Coach on commercial domain knowledge, agile delivery, engineering discipline, data quality, testing, documentation and responsible AI.

• 
Deliver end to end: guide work from opportunity assessment and data readiness through proof of concept, MVP, production, adoption and continuous improvement. Work closely with architects on standards for design, reusable data models, code reviews, testing, model validation, monitoring and support handover.

• 
Track value and reliability: define and monitor business KPIs, adoption, quality and service health, so products keep delivering value after launch.

• 
Embed governance and responsible AI: work with legal, privacy, IT security and risk to ensure trusted data sources, clear ownership, access controls, lineage, GDPR compliance, transparency and human oversight.

Who you’ll work with

You will lead a multidisciplinary team in Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, stay close to stakeholders and help deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working.

You will be the bridge between Commercial and technology. Your closest partners will be Commercial business teams and product owners, along with enterprise architecture, platform teams, data governance, privacy, legal and operations. You will also work with senior business leaders and affiliates, turning Commercial opportunities into clear problem statements, solution options and delivery plans that technical and non-technical colleagues can act on.

Together, you will remove blockers, create clarity on priorities and embed new tools in daily decision-making.

What you can expect here

Data and AI are strategic priorities at Novo, and you will have strong leadership sponsorship for this work. You will influence Commercial strategy, partner with senior executives and help define how AI changes decision-making in a rapidly evolving pharmaceutical landscape.

You will be trusted to take ownership and be supported to perform at your best, in a culture that values curiosity and innovation. You will grow your leadership and technology career by leading a talented team, working across functions and building new skills along the way.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 940,800.00 to 1,448,700.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead a team and shape how AI supports Commercial decisions across Novo, apply for the AI Lead role by 8 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Your impact begins here

As Associate Consumer Pricing Director, you will lead pricing and deal strategy for non-traditional channels across EUCAN: e-health and online channels, online pharmacies and e-commerce, direct-to-employer and private health insurance. Obesity is your primary focus. You will shape how deals are designed, negotiated and put into practice, while protecting the pricing system that supports access across markets. Your work helps more people living with serious chronic disease reach treatment, through routes that fit real life.

What you’ll bring

You combine pricing expertise with commercial understanding and the confidence to influence decisions at every level.

• An M.Sc. or MBA in economics, business administration, finance or a similar field.

• At least 7 years of experience in pharma pricing, market access, business analytics or finance, from an affiliate, regional or headquarter role, or from a consultancy.

• Proven expertise in international reference pricing (IRP) and parallel trade risk, HTA, launch planning, mature brand and generic life-cycle management, and budget  and forecasting processes.

• Strong project and stakeholder management, and strong interpersonal skills.

• Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate and influence across multiple levels, internally and externally.

• Business acumen and a problem-solving mindset that turns analysis into decisions that support patient access and business goals.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience negotiating commercial deals.

• Experience with e-commerce or digital health business models.

What you’ll do

You will be the recognised expert on commercial channel pricing in EUCAN, turning analysis into clear recommendations and deals that work in practice.

Lead commercial pricing and deal strategy for non-traditional channels

• Set the pricing strategy for e-health and online prescribers, online pharmacies and e-commerce, direct-to-employer and private health insurance across EUCAN, with obesity as the focus and the wider portfolio in view.

• Develop deal structures and pricing guardrails for non-traditional players, in alignment with IO Pricing.

• Lead gross-to-net and discount analytics to inform deal design and pricing decisions.

Lead the design, negotiation and governance of deals with key accounts

• Give recommendations and input to key account management for EUCAN-level providers, and support negotiations with selected key accounts.

• Support affiliates in implementing agreed deals, from negotiation preparation and deal terms to follow-up.

• Develop and present recommendations to the EUCAN Pricing Council and to IO and HQ pricing teams.

Safeguard the core pricing system across the portfolio

• Assess and mitigate IRP and parallel trade risks arising from net prices in commercial channels.

• Monitor the online channel, competitor prices and the market access, HTA and pricing landscape across EUCAN, and flag risks and opportunities to your manager and the Pricing Council.

• Contribute to launch planning for new products, indications and formulations, and lead pricing life-cycle strategies for mature brands and generic and biosimilar insights, in coordination with Commercial.

• Support key processes, including annual budget planning and long-term forecasting, with recommendations, analytics and quality assurance.

Build pricing analytics, insights and capabilities

• Lead the development of commercial pricing capabilities, tools and best practices across the region and affiliates, and mentor colleagues in your field of expertise.

• Keep affiliates informed with timely communication, and share relevant best practices and information.

• Contribute to cross-functional team processes, including team meetings, budget and launch planning, and manage the budget for your own tasks and external projects.

Who you’ll work with

You will join EUCAN Pricing & Market Access in International Operations, where colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale. Your responsibility covers the EUCAN region and your assigned therapy area(s), with specific countries managed as key accounts.

Your closest partners are the affiliates you support in negotiations and deal implementation, key account management, and Business Development. You will also work with IO and HQ pricing teams and present to the EUCAN Pricing Council, so decisions are made with clarity and at pace. You will report to Senior Director Pricing & Market Access

What you can expect here

You will work in an international environment where your expertise shapes decisions across Europe and Canada.

The role offers real breadth with opportunities to work on Obesity and collaborate across the value chain and build new skills through regional and affiliate work. You will be trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard, supported to perform at your best in a team that combines curiosity, collaboration and ambition.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 931,670.00 to 1,369,660.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits

The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

As Advanced Process Supporter, you will keep a tablet packaging line in Måløv running steadily and in line with GMP. Operators turn to you when a process issue, quality question or deviation needs a clear answer, and you use what you learn to improve how the line works. Your work helps tablets packed in blisters reach people around the world on time and in the highest quality.

What you’ll bring

This is a hands-on role close to production, so we are looking for someone with manufacturing experience who is ready to take ownership.

• A Bachelor’s degree in engineering (e.g. production, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, chemical, or mechanical) or another relevant discipline.

• Extensive experience in process support, production support, process engineering or a similar manufacturing support role.

• Experience from a GMP-regulated or other regulated manufacturing environment, with sound judgement on quality and compliance in live production situations.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and enjoyment in working through complex production challenges.

• Fluency in Danish and English.

• A structured way of working, with consistent follow-up until issues are closed.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience from a packaging line.

• Basic familiarity with PAS-X.

• Experience with process improvement.

What you’ll do

• You will support the packaging line day to day, so production stays stable and compliant, and look for ways to make it better.

• Provide daily process support to the packaging line, including technical guidance, knowledge sharing and training within the production area.

• Troubleshoot and resolve process-, operator- and quality-related issues, such as procedures not followed correctly or product questions that arise during production.

• Make sure production follows GMP requirements and approved procedures.

• Handle and support deviations, change requests and other quality activities, using structured problem solving and root cause analysis.

• Identify and lead smaller improvement initiatives that strengthen process performance, quality and productivity.

• Participate in a planned 24-hour on-call rotation, typically 1–2 days per week, including out-of-hours support.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Process Support team in Tablets & Finished Products at the Måløv site, part of Global Manufacturing & Supply. The team of 11 supports the packaging line and includes seven process supporters, plus reviewers and an editor. Collaboration, development and continuous improvement are central to how it works.

Your closest partners are operators, technicians, QA, maintenance and production management. You will gather information from the floor, build strong working relationships and coordinate people so issues are solved quickly. When something stalls, you speak up and help move it forward.

What you can expect here

This role puts you at the centre of a production line that people depend on, and gives you the room to shape how it runs. You will learn from colleagues who know the line well and get training and onboarding with backup until you feel confident. We value people who raise the bar, so clear expectations, honest feedback and the chance to lead smaller improvements are part of the everyday work. Your results are noticed and recognised, and you keep building new skills through hands-on experience and relevant learning offerings.

jobs.occupation: PhD Stipend in Experimental Quantum Materials Physics
jobs.description:
Join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production at Aalborg University and contribute to research on the quantum properties of matter at the scale of individual atoms and molecules. This is a full-time, fixed-term PhD stipend for three years, commencing on 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter

**Your work tasks

**The Department of Materials and Production is looking for a PhD candidate in experimental physics to investigate how molecular complexes can be used to engineer quantum properties in materials. The project addresses fundamental questions in quantum science while contributing knowledge that may support future applications within electronics, sensing and energy harvesting. You will become part of the Physics Group and work in an international research collaboration funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark.

Your research will focus on preparing and investigating molecular complexes on crystalline surfaces. You will deposit molecular complexes by electrospray techniques under ultra-high-vacuum conditions and study their structural and electronic properties using low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. The work will involve planning and conducting experiments, documenting methods and results, analysing and discussing data, and communicating findings clearly within the research collaboration and through relevant scientific channels. You will carry out a substantial part of the research independently while collaborating closely with researchers in the project.

Your competencies You hold a master's degree in physics, nanoscience or a closely related field. You have a solid experimental background within physics, surface science or nanoscience, together with documented experience in scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, ultra-high-vacuum techniques, cryogenic systems, surface science and electrospray deposition.

You can organise and conduct experimental research in a systematic manner, from the planning of measurements to the documentation, analysis and interpretation of results. You communicate methods and findings clearly in English, both in writing and in dialogue with other researchers. The position calls for a researcher who can take responsibility for their own work while contributing constructively to a collaborative and international research environment.

**Qualification requirements

**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are

You will join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production, where research activities explore materials and physical phenomena relevant to both fundamental science and future technologies. In this position, you will work at the intersection of molecular science, surface science and quantum materials research, with access to a research environment in which experimental methods and scientific discussion form the basis for developing new knowledge.

As part of an international collaboration, you will have the opportunity to engage with researchers across disciplines and contribute to a research project with both scientific depth and technological relevance. The position offers a strong foundation for further work in academic research, advanced experimental physics or research-intensive development environments.

**How to apply

**Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)

• Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment

**The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Ready to lead change with us?

SORTH & CO is searching on behalf of Elopak Denmark A/S

PLANT DIRECTOR

Full responsibility for the performance of Elopak's production site in Lystrup, including safety, quality, delivery and cost. Succeeding a long-serving predecessor, you will have the mandate to shape culture, ways of working and leadership focus.

You will drive operational excellence based on TPM and serve as Managing Director of Elopak Denmark A/S, while leading major new projects launching in 2027.

Elopak is one of the world’s leading suppliers of carton packaging for liquid food products. Headquartered in Oslo and employing more than 2,850 people across 40 countries, Elopak is driven by a shared vision: creating sustainable packaging solutions that leave an undamaged world for future generations.

Elopak Denmark A/S is part of the global Elopak Group. It has a large production site in Lystrup near Aarhus with approximately 310 employees, and it works closely within a Nordic matrix structure across Technical Service, Aftermarket and Sales.

Read more about Elopak: https://www.elopak.com/

As Plant Director, you will lead the Danish production site with P&L responsibility. You will head a stable and well-functioning management team and focus on developing the culture, strengthening capabilities and shaping future leadership, while keeping operations stable and OEE high.

The Elopak Group has invested significantly in the Danish site, and new key projects will launch in Q1 2027. You will be responsible for ensuring smooth start-ups and efficient operations going forward. You will work closely with central functions as well as Sales and R&D in an international matrix organisation.

The Plant Director reports to the Global EVP Packaging and Procurement. The position is based full-time at the production site in Lystrup, Aarhus, Denmark.

Your responsibilities will include:

Site leadership

• Overall responsibility for site performance across safety, quality, delivery and cost

• Lead and develop the management team and serve as formal Managing Director of Elopak Denmark A/S

Strategic projects

• Oversee major projects and ensure smooth start-up and implementation

• Lead the introduction of new products and formats

Operational excellence

• Drive continuous improvement based on TPM, improving OEE and reducing downtime and waste

• Engage leaders at all levels as ambassadors for operational excellence

Safety and culture

• Lead the safety agenda and build a strong, proactive safety culture

• Act as a visible HSE role model on the shop floor

The suitable candidate

To succeed in this role, you know what it takes to run an efficient high-volume production on commercial terms, you lead in a way that engages an experienced team, and you excel across the full spectrum from strategy to daily operations.

We expect the successful candidate to bring:

• Several years of senior leadership experience in manufacturing, ideally as Plant Manager, Plant Director or Operations Director, from industries such as FMCG, food and beverage, packaging or paper – or from other comparable high-volume areas

• A proven track record of working with TPM standards and driving operational excellence, as well as leading new and complex projects

• Solid HSE experience, ideally from an organisation with a strong safety culture

• A visible, engaging leader who spends time on the shop floor, turns strategy into clear priorities and develops people and teams

• Combines high standards and accountability with a supportive, collaborative style, and works well across functions in an international matrix organisation

• Hands-on, solution-oriented and fact-based, with strong ownership and the ability to build trust at all levels

• Fluent in Danish and English, written and spoken

Elopak offers a central leadership position in an international organisation with strong values, high ambitions and a clear sustainability agenda. You will have significant influence on the future of the Danish site, and you will get the chance to shape both operational results and organisational capabilities.

The recruitment process is handled by SORTH & CO. If you have any questions, please contact Head of Search Sofie Kruse Møller, sofie@sorthco.dk or Partner Thomas Hansen, th@sorthco.dk.
